modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: How much cabin baggage you can bring depends on your fare; excess is charged at check-in or, at a higher rate, at the gate.

carryon_weight.value: A single piece of cabin baggage must not weigh more than 10 kg. Small personal items (handbag, laptop bag) go under the seat in front.
carryon_weight.notes: The per-fare allowance table did not survive capture; only the per-piece weight limit is published here.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: The allowance is the total weight of checked baggage per passenger and depends on your fare.

size_weight.value: Each checked bag up to 158 cm (length + width + height) and never more than 32 kg, whatever allowance you booked. Strollers, buggies, baby beds and car seats (up to two per child) travel free.
